basics.name: Sarah Chen
basics.summary: Experienced full-stack software engineer with 8+ years developing scalable web applications. Passionate about artificial intelligence, cloud technologies, and building solutions that impact millions of users. Led cross-functional teams to deliver complex projects on time and under budget.

work.summary: Lead development of microservices architecture serving 50M+ users. Implemented CI/CD pipelines reducing deployment time by 80%. Mentored 5 junior developers and established engineering best practices.
highlights: Architected and implemented scalable microservices handling 1M+ requests/day
Reduced system latency by 60% through database optimization and caching strategies
Led migration from monolithic to microservices architecture
Implemented comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems

work.summary: Developed AI-powered analytics platform processing billions of data points. Built responsive web applications using React and Node.js. Collaborated with data scientists to implement machine learning models.
highlights: Built real-time analytics dashboard serving 10K+ concurrent users
Implemented machine learning pipeline for predictive analytics
Optimized database queries improving performance by 3x
Developed REST APIs used by 20+ internal services

work.summary: Full-stack development on e-commerce platform. Worked directly with founders to build MVP and scale to 100K+ users. Gained experience with agile development and startup culture.
highlights: Built customer-facing e-commerce platform from scratch
Implemented payment processing and fraud detection systems
Collaborated with design team to implement pixel-perfect interfaces

projects.name: AI-Powered Job Matching Platform
projects.description: Built an intelligent job matching system using NLP and machine learning to connect candidates with relevant opportunities
highlights: Processed 1M+ job postings using NLP techniques
Served 50K+ active users with personalized recommendations

projects.name: Real-time Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Developed a scalable real-time analytics platform for monitoring business metrics and user behavior
highlights: Handled 10M+ events per day with sub-second latency
Built interactive dashboards with custom visualizations

references.name: Dr. Michael Rodriguez
references.reference: Sarah is an exceptional engineer with deep technical expertise and strong leadership skills. She consistently delivers high-quality solutions and mentors team members effectively.
